description: Telangana HC taken serious note of the Jangaon district collector allegedly relying on AI to issue orders in revenue matters.
body_lead: Hyderabad: The Telangana High Court has taken serious note of the Jangaon district collector allegedly relying on artificial intelligence (AI) to issue orders in revenue matters. The observation was made by Justice NV Shravan Kumar on Tuesday, November 3, while hearing a petition filed by Madipelly Komuraiah, a resident of Peddamadur village in Devaruppula mandal of Jangaon district. The petitioner approached the court challenging an order issued by the district collector on September 8 in connection with a land dispute.
